population: all 1669 OPM membrane assemblies (<=4.0 A) passing physical-validity + plausible-c0 QC
label_rule: assembly is label-positive if ANY of its subunit UniProts carries >=1 of the 9 GO terms
hypothesis: structure-derived E_curv is POSITIVELY associated with curvature/entry GO annotation
tests: Mann-Whitney U one-sided AUROC (label+ higher E_curv)
gate enrichment: label-positive rate among gate-clearers vs base rate
decision_rule: SUPPORT iff AUROC>0.5 AND one-sided p<0.10 AND Spearman rho>0; else null/refute; reported per rule, not re-tuned
